blocks.en: Section 1: Introduction & Scope

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ICH Q8(R2) 在 CTD 送審文件 3.2.P.2 中的定位與法規意義
blocks.en: Understand the position and regulatory significance of ICH Q8(R2) within CTD section 3.2.P.2

blocks.zh: 掌握 Quality by Design (QbD) 的核心理念：品質不是測出來的，是設計進去的
blocks.en: Grasp the core idea of Quality by Design (QbD): quality is not tested into a product, it is designed in

blocks.zh: 理解 Design Space 的概念與其帶來的法規彈性（無需送審的變更範圍）
blocks.en: Understand the concept of the Design Space and the regulatory flexibility it brings (a range of changes that need no regulatory submission)

blocks.zh: 認識 Q8(R2) 與 ICH Q9（風險管理）、ICH Q10（品質系統）的三角互補關係
blocks.en: Recognize how Q8(R2), ICH Q9 (risk management) and ICH Q10 (quality system) complement one another as a triangle

blocks.zh: 了解本指南如何為 CDMO 帶來更靈活的製程優化空間
blocks.en: See how this guideline gives CDMOs more flexible room for process optimization

blocks.zh: 1.1 Objective of the Guideline｜指南目的
blocks.en: 1.1 Objective of the Guideline

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: CTD 3.2.P.2（Pharmaceutical Development，藥品開發）：這是 NDA/MAA 申請文件中最重要的 CMC 章節之一，描述「你為什麼這樣設計這個產品和製程」的科學理由。
blocks.en: CTD 3.2.P.2 (Pharmaceutical Development): One of the most important CMC sections of an NDA/MAA, it sets out the scientific rationale for "why you designed this product and process the way you did."

blocks.zh: ICH M4（Common Technical Document，通用技術文件）：全球三大法規區域（US/EU/JP）共同認可的藥品申請格式，分五個模組（M1-M5）。3.2.P.2 在 Module 3（品質）之下。
blocks.en: ICH M4 (Common Technical Document): The drug application format recognized jointly by the three major regulatory regions (US/EU/JP), organized into five modules (M1-M5). 3.2.P.2 sits under Module 3 (Quality).

blocks.zh: Flexible Regulatory Approaches（法規彈性）：若你在 3.2.P.2 展現足夠的科學理解，法規機關可以給你更大的空間——如 Design Space 內的改變不需送審。
blocks.en: Flexible Regulatory Approaches: If you demonstrate sufficient scientific understanding in 3.2.P.2, regulators can give you more latitude, for example, changes within the Design Space need no submission.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把 3.2.P.2 想像成蓋房子的建築師設計說明書。政府審查員不只想看你蓋了什麼房子，他們要看你「為什麼這樣設計」——為什麼選這種材料、為什麼採這個結構、為什麼這樣防震。你解釋得越完整、越有科學依據，審查員越放心，未來你要小改格局也可以不用重新申請建照。
blocks.en: Think of 3.2.P.2 as the architect's design statement for a building. Government reviewers do not just want to see what you built; they want to see "why you designed it this way": why this material, why this structure, why this earthquake protection. The more completely you explain it and the stronger the scientific basis, the more comfortable the reviewers are, and the later you can make minor layout changes without reapplying for a building permit.

blocks.zh: 反之，如果你只給一張設計圖而沒有說明，任何一根柱子的位置改動都要重新申請——這就是不提交 Q8 風格開發研究的代價。
blocks.en: Conversely, if you hand over only a drawing with no explanation, moving even a single column means a new application. That is the price of not submitting Q8-style development studies.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 法規彈性的前提是科學說明：「The degree of regulatory flexibility is predicated on the level of relevant scientific knowledge provided」——這句話是 Q8 的核心精神。你給的科學知識越多，拿到的彈性越大。
blocks.en: Regulatory flexibility is predicated on scientific explanation: "The degree of regulatory flexibility is predicated on the level of relevant scientific knowledge provided." This sentence is the core spirit of Q8. The more scientific knowledge you provide, the more flexibility you gain.

blocks.zh: 動態更新文件：3.2.P.2 不是一次性文件，產品整個生命週期中獲得的新知識都可以更新它。這是 Q10（品質系統）中「知識管理」的體現。
blocks.en: A living document: 3.2.P.2 is not a one-time document; new knowledge gained throughout the product lifecycle can be used to update it. This is the embodiment of "knowledge management" in Q10 (quality system).

blocks.zh: Q8 + Q9 + Q10 三角：Q8 提供開發知識架構，Q9 提供風險評估工具，Q10 提供持續改善機制。這三者是密不可分的。
blocks.en: The Q8 + Q9 + Q10 triangle: Q8 provides the framework for development knowledge, Q9 provides the risk assessment tools, and Q10 provides the mechanism for continual improvement. The three are inseparable.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application for CDMOs

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，幫客戶準備一份高品質的 3.2.P.2 是高附加價值的服務。許多創新藥公司（尤其是 Biotech）在技術轉移給 CDMO 時，其 3.2.P.2 仍非常薄弱。CDMO 若能協助建立完整的開發數據包（development package），不但能加速審查，也能在後期商業化階段享有更多製程優化彈性。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, helping a client prepare a high-quality 3.2.P.2 is a high-value service. Many innovator companies (especially biotechs) still have a very weak 3.2.P.2 when they transfer technology to a CDMO. If the CDMO can help build a complete development package, it not only speeds up review but also enjoys more process optimization flexibility at the later commercialization stage.

blocks.zh: 1.2 Scope｜適用範圍
blocks.en: 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：Q8(R2) 正式適用於 NDA/MAA 的商業化申請（不適用臨床研究階段的提交），但其原則在臨床開發各階段都應考慮——這一點對 CDMO 在早期技術轉移時非常重要。
blocks.en: Scope: Q8(R2) formally applies to commercial NDA/MAA submissions (it does not apply to submissions during the clinical research stage), but its principles should be considered at every stage of clinical development. This is very important for CDMOs during early-stage technology transfer.

blocks.zh: Quality Built In by Design（設計入品質）：這是 QbD 的靈魂。傳統作法是「先做再測，測出來達標就好」；QbD 的作法是「理解每個關鍵屬性（CQA）和製程參數（CPP）的關係，讓製程本身就能保證品質」。
blocks.en: Quality Built In by Design: This is the soul of QbD. The traditional approach is "make it first, then test, and if it passes, that is enough." The QbD approach is "understand the relationship between each critical attribute (CQA) and process parameter (CPP), so that the process itself assures quality."

blocks.zh: Design Space（設計空間）：多維度的原料屬性和製程參數的組合範圍，在此範圍內操作能保證產品品質。在 Design Space 內調整不算「重大變更」，不需送 post-approval supplement。
blocks.en: Design Space: The multidimensional combination range of material attributes and process parameters within which operating assures product quality. Adjusting within the Design Space is not a "major change" and does not require a post-approval supplement.

blocks.zh: 「品質不是測出來的」——想像你在做餐廳的招牌牛排。傳統方法是：每塊牛排煎好後試味道，不夠好就丟掉。QbD 方法是：搞清楚火候（幾度幾分鐘）、牛肉厚度（幾公分）、靜置時間（幾分鐘）的精確組合，只要在這個「設計空間」內操作，每一塊牛排都會是完美的——你根本不需要逐塊試吃。
blocks.en: "Quality cannot be tested into products": Imagine you are cooking the signature steak at a restaurant. The traditional method is to taste every steak after cooking and throw away any that is not good enough. The QbD method is to work out the precise combination of heat (what temperature, how many minutes), beef thickness (how many centimeters) and resting time (how many minutes); as long as you operate within this "design space," every steak will be perfect, and you do not need to taste each one.

blocks.zh: 這個「幾度幾分鐘、幾公分厚、靜置幾分鐘」的操作範圍，就是 Design Space。在範圍內調整火候 ±5°C，不需要向衛生局重新申請菜單變更。
blocks.en: This operating range of "what temperature and how many minutes, how many centimeters thick, how many minutes of resting" is the Design Space. Adjusting the heat by ±5°C within the range does not require reapplying to the health department for a menu change.

blocks.zh: Early-stage 適用性：雖然 Q8 法規要求是商業申請，但 Annex（Part II）專門處理「phase-appropriate approach」——臨床各階段該做多少開發研究。CMC 人員應在 Phase 1 就開始規劃 Q8 架構。
blocks.en: Applicability at early stages: Although the Q8 regulatory requirement concerns commercial applications, the Annex (Part II) specifically addresses the "phase-appropriate approach," meaning how much development work is appropriate at each clinical phase. CMC staff should start planning the Q8 framework as early as Phase 1.

blocks.zh: 「Quality cannot be tested into products」是最重要的一句話：這句話常出現在 FDA 483、Warning Letter 中。如果你只靠 QC 放行而沒有製程理解，法規機關會認為你的品質控制是不充分的。
blocks.en: "Quality cannot be tested into products" is the most important sentence: This sentence often appears in FDA 483s and Warning Letters. If you rely only on QC release without process understanding, regulators will consider your quality control inadequate.

blocks.zh: Design Space vs. Proven Acceptable Ranges (PAR)：Design Space 是多變數、有互動關係的範圍；PAR 是各個參數的單一範圍（univariate）。Design Space 需要更多 DOE 數據，但換來更大的操作彈性。
blocks.en: Design Space vs. Proven Acceptable Ranges (PAR): A Design Space is a multivariate range that accounts for interactions; a PAR is a single range for each individual parameter (univariate). A Design Space requires more DOE data but gives greater operating flexibility in return.

blocks.zh: 概念架構 Conceptual Framework
blocks.en: Conceptual Framework

blocks.zh: 傳統方法 vs. QbD 方法
blocks.en: Traditional approach vs. QbD approach

blocks.zh:
傳統 (Traditional):
  製程 → 固定操作條件 → 產品 → QC 測試 → 放行/不放行

QbD:
  QTPP（目標品質概況）
    ↓
  CQA（關鍵品質屬性）鑑別
    ↓
  Risk Assessment 連結 CQA ← CPP/CMA
    ↓
  Design Space（多變數操作範圍）
    ↓
  Control Strategy（控制策略）
    ↓
  PAT / Real-Time Release（即時放行）
blocks.en:
Traditional:
  Process → Fixed operating conditions → Product → QC testing → Release / Reject

QbD:
  QTPP (Quality Target Product Profile)
    ↓
  CQA (Critical Quality Attribute) identification
    ↓
  Risk Assessment linking CQA ← CPP/CMA
    ↓
  Design Space (multivariate operating range)
    ↓
  Control Strategy
    ↓
  PAT / Real-Time Release

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 正在幫客戶做技術轉移，客戶只提供了一個固定的製程配方和操作條件，沒有任何 Design Space 數據。對 CDMO 的商業風險是什麼？
blocks.en: A CDMO is performing a technology transfer for a client, and the client provides only a fixed process recipe and operating conditions, with no Design Space data. What is the commercial risk to the CDMO?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 和 EMA 都鼓勵廠商提交 Design Space？法規機關的好處是什麼？廠商的好處又是什麼？
blocks.en: Why do both FDA and EMA encourage companies to submit a Design Space? What is the benefit to the regulators, and what is the benefit to the company?

blocks.zh: 「Quality built in by design」和「Quality by testing」的差異，在一批 API 含量測試不合格時會如何體現不同的後果？
blocks.en: How do "quality built in by design" and "quality by testing" differ in their consequences when a batch of API fails the assay test?

blocks.zh: Section 2 Overview｜藥品開發概論（QbD 框架導覽）
blocks.en: Section 2 Overview: Introduction to Pharmaceutical Development (QbD Framework Tour)

blocks.zh: Design Space 的法規地位：由申請人提出，法規機關審核批准。一旦批准，在 Design Space 內調整操作條件「不算變更」——這是 QbD 帶來的核心商業價值。
blocks.en: Regulatory status of the Design Space: It is proposed by the applicant and approved by the regulatory authority. Once approved, adjusting operating conditions within the Design Space is "not considered a change." This is the core commercial value QbD delivers.

blocks.zh: Post-Approval Change（批准後變更）：傳統製程若要修改任何條件（如混合時間、溫度範圍），通常需要提交 CBE-30 或 Prior Approval Supplement，費時費力。有 Design Space 的廠商可省去大量的後期申請。
blocks.en: Post-Approval Change: In a traditional process, modifying any condition (such as mixing time or temperature range) usually requires a CBE-30 or Prior Approval Supplement, which is time-consuming and laborious. Companies with a Design Space can avoid a large number of later filings.

blocks.zh: PAT（Process Analytical Technology，製程分析技術）：使用即時分析工具（如 NIR、拉曼光譜）在製程中直接監測 CQA，不需等到成品才做 QC 測試。PAT 是 Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) 的技術基礎。
blocks.en: PAT (Process Analytical Technology): Using real-time analytical tools (such as NIR or Raman spectroscopy) to monitor CQAs directly during the process, without waiting for QC testing of the finished product. PAT is the technical foundation of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT).

blocks.zh: Experimental Designs（實驗設計）：DOE（Design of Experiments）——系統性地同時改變多個因素，建立多變數的理解，而非傳統的「改一個、固定其他」單因素實驗。
blocks.en: Experimental Designs: DOE (Design of Experiments) systematically changes multiple factors at the same time to build multivariate understanding, rather than the traditional one-factor-at-a-time experiment where the others are held fixed.

blocks.zh: 「失敗的實驗也是知識」——這句話在工業界常被忽略。Q8 明確指出："inclusion of relevant knowledge gained from experiments giving unexpected results can also be useful."
blocks.en: "Failed experiments are also knowledge." This is often overlooked in industry. Q8 states explicitly: "inclusion of relevant knowledge gained from experiments giving unexpected results can also be useful."

blocks.zh: 想像你在測試一個新的製錠製程，某批次因為混合時間過長導致混合過度（over-mixing），顆粒太細，片劑脆碎強度不足。這個「失敗」實驗告訴你 Design Space 的邊界——混合時間的上限。把這個數據寫進 3.2.P.2，就是 Design Space 邊界的科學依據。
blocks.en: Imagine you are testing a new tablet manufacturing process, and one batch was over-mixed because the mixing time was too long, producing granules that were too fine and tablets with insufficient friability strength. This "failed" experiment tells you where the boundary of the Design Space lies: the upper limit of mixing time. Writing this data into 3.2.P.2 provides the scientific basis for that Design Space boundary.

blocks.zh: 四大法規彈性：Q8 明確列出 Enhanced Approach 帶來的四個好處：① 風險導向審查、② 在 Design Space 內改變無需重新審查、③ 減少批准後申請、④ RTRT 減少成品測試。這四點是說服客戶投資 QbD 研究的最佳論據。
blocks.en: The four regulatory flexibilities: Q8 explicitly lists four benefits of the Enhanced Approach: (1) risk-based regulatory review, (2) changes within the Design Space need no further review, (3) fewer post-approval submissions, and (4) reduced end-product testing through RTRT. These four points are the best arguments for persuading a client to invest in QbD studies.

blocks.zh: Prior Knowledge（先驗知識）也算：文獻資料、平台技術、歷史批次數據，都可以作為建立 Design Space 的依據，不一定要從頭做所有實驗。對 CDMO 而言，累積的多產品平台經驗本身就是競爭優勢。
blocks.en: Prior Knowledge counts too: Literature, platform technology and historical batch data can all serve as the basis for establishing a Design Space; you do not have to run every experiment from scratch. For a CDMO, accumulated multi-product platform experience is itself a competitive advantage.

blocks.zh: Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT)：傳統放行需要等待 28 天穩定性和各項 QC 結果；RTRT 用 PAT 數據即時判斷品質，可以大幅縮短 cycle time。對注射劑等需要快速商業化的品項特別有價值。
blocks.en: Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT): Traditional release requires waiting for 28-day stability and various QC results; RTRT uses PAT data to judge quality in real time, which can greatly shorten cycle time. It is especially valuable for products such as injectables that need to reach the market quickly.

blocks.zh: 設計空間的商業談判籌碼：當 CDMO 協助客戶建立了完整的 Design Space，這個 Design Space 就是雙方未來彈性操作的「合法邊界」。如果客戶未來想換 API 供應商（可能影響 CMA）、或者擴大批量（Scale-up），只要還在 Design Space 內，不需要重新送審，雙方都省下大量時間和費用。這對合約談判是重要的差異化賣點。
blocks.en: The Design Space as commercial negotiating leverage: When a CDMO helps a client establish a complete Design Space, that Design Space becomes the "legitimate boundary" for flexible operation by both parties in the future. If the client later wants to change API supplier (which may affect CMAs) or scale up the batch size, as long as the change stays within the Design Space, no resubmission is needed, and both sides save a great deal of time and cost. This is an important differentiating selling point in contract negotiations.

blocks.zh: 初期投資：建立 Design Space 需要更多 DOE 實驗（開發成本 +20-40%）
blocks.en: Initial investment: Establishing a Design Space requires more DOE experiments (development cost +20-40%)

blocks.zh: 長期回報：生命週期內減少 post-approval supplement，每次省約 $50K-$200K 和 6-18 個月時間
blocks.en: Long-term return: Fewer post-approval supplements over the lifecycle, saving roughly $50K-$200K and 6-18 months each time

blocks.zh: 一個藥廠在商業化後發現某批次 API 的粒徑分布比平常更廣，這個變化可能影響溶出速率。在傳統方法下 vs. QbD（有 Design Space）下，廠商的處理流程分別是什麼？哪個更有效率？
blocks.en: After commercialization, a pharmaceutical company finds that the particle size distribution of a batch of API is wider than usual, and this change could affect the dissolution rate. How would the company handle it under the traditional approach versus under QbD (with a Design Space)? Which is more efficient?

blocks.zh: PAT 的引入需要什麼前提條件？廠商在導入 NIR 含量均勻度測試時，需要向法規機關提交哪些數據？
blocks.en: What prerequisites are needed to introduce PAT? When implementing an NIR content uniformity test, what data must the company submit to the regulatory authority?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 DOE（Design of Experiments）優於 OFAT（One Factor At a Time）？用一個具體的製程開發情境說明。
blocks.en: Why is DOE (Design of Experiments) better than OFAT (One Factor At a Time)? Explain with a specific process development scenario.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Q8(R2) 的定位：規範 CTD Module 3 中 3.2.P.2（Pharmaceutical Development）的內容，是呈現開發科學知識的正式場所
blocks.en: Position of Q8(R2): It governs the content of 3.2.P.2 (Pharmaceutical Development) in CTD Module 3, the formal place to present development scientific knowledge

blocks.zh: QbD 核心精神：Quality built in by design——品質是設計出來的，不是測出來的；法規彈性的大小取決於你提供科學知識的深度
blocks.en: Core spirit of QbD: Quality built in by design. Quality is designed in, not tested in; the amount of regulatory flexibility depends on the depth of scientific knowledge you provide

blocks.zh: Design Space：由申請人提出、法規機關批准的多維操作範圍；在其內調整不算「變更」，是 QbD 最直接的商業回報
blocks.en: Design Space: A multidimensional operating range proposed by the applicant and approved by the regulatory authority; adjusting within it is not a "change," and it is the most direct commercial return of QbD

blocks.zh: 工具箱：DOE（建立多變數理解）+ PAT（即時監測）+ Risk Assessment（識別 CQA/CPP）共同支撐 QbD 架構
blocks.en: Toolbox: DOE (building multivariate understanding) + PAT (real-time monitoring) + Risk Assessment (identifying CQAs/CPPs) together support the QbD framework

blocks.zh: Q8 + Q9 + Q10：三指南相互支撐，Q8 是知識的系統化呈現，Q9 提供風險評估方法，Q10 確保知識管理和持續改善
blocks.en: Q8 + Q9 + Q10: The three guidelines support one another; Q8 is the systematic presentation of knowledge, Q9 provides risk assessment methods, and Q10 ensures knowledge management and continual improvement
